review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Implement a minimal shared attachment identity correction and render-time echo retirement
review.notes: Installed179 actual GET history for current57 contains text, a bare attachment path and a generated Markdown Image#1 for the same file. Existing identity counts both representations as separate images, unlike the outgoing Composer payload. Preserve original prompt display, distinct text/path/order/count, code fences, malformed/remote references, prior occurrence protection, send IDs/target identity/unknown no-replay. Treat matching complete ordered bare and rendered inventories as two representations of the same attachments; do not globally deduplicate files. Hide a newly recorded optimistic echo in the first committed render instead of waiting for effect cleanup. Both HQ and Detail plus the generated browser contract. No real sends/queues, HQ exit/resume, new release/install or permissions in tests. CUA currently cgWindowNotFound; component tests do not certify physical phone UI. Mapping review before final test publication: split the unchanged identity assertions into attachmentEchoIdentity.test.ts (L1), leaving real component commit assertions in attachmentEchoReconciliation.test.tsx (L2), so file-level catalogue layers remain accurate. Preserve the earlier draft old-red evidence and all assertion expectations; this is a test organization correction, not added scope. The original draft path remains an allowed historical plan path; the final implementation map binds AEC-001 only to the new L1 file.

cases.description: Native/browser identity matches dual attachment representations without conflating distinct attachments
cases.setup: Synthetic Composer body/path inventory and transcript body plus matching rendered image links or empty XML envelopes; paths with spaces, two files and repeated same-file attachments
cases.action: Compare shared production identity and existing native/browser echo matching on new and old transcript occurrences
cases.expected: Matching complete ordered bare/rendered inventories count once per actual attachment; different body/path/order/count, malformed/remote links and fenced examples stay distinct. Repeated identical pre-existing history is never a new receipt. Source display text remains unchanged. Old production must fail the dual-representation positive cases.

cases.description: HQ and Detail retire the confirmed echo in the first committed transcript render
cases.setup: Production React screens with controlled synthetic transcript and sendResult, layout-effect commit observer, empty/old matching history and accepted/queued or late receipt
cases.action: Submit one synthetic message then publish its new same-session dual-representation transcript; also test plain text, prior identical occurrences and late receipt after confirmation
cases.expected: One underlying send only. New recorded prompt is visible and no committed frame includes its optimistic duplicate; pending/awaiting status disappears at that same commit and late receipt cannot restore it. A historical identical occurrence still leaves a new send pending. Shared behavior applies independently to HQ and Detail; existing retry/ordering guards remain. Tests never contact a live server.
